cork_involution_tau.action: component-exchange (dot-zero) symmetry sigma of the symmetric Mazur link: orientation-preserving involution of S^3 exchanging U <-> K as unoriented knots (dotted role swapped), inducing fixed-point-free orientation-preserving involution tau on Y = partial C
cork_involution_tau.description: Mazur boundary involution via symmetric-link dot-zero swap (Akbulut-cork type). By symmetry sigma, the two handle presentations (U dotted, K 0-framed) and (K dotted, U 0-framed) have identical front data; (tb,rot) = (1,0) on both sides.
cork_involution_tau.extension: tau extends to a homeomorphism of C (Freedman) but is the candidate non-extending diffeomorphism (cork property); raw boundary dbar cannot obstruct it (see vanishing lemma)

components.smooth_type: unknot in S^3 (ribbon band-sum of three strands through U-disk with one compensating clasp)

link_data.component_symmetry: link (U,K) admits orientation-preserving involution sigma exchanging U <-> K (symmetric clasp); linking matrix [[0,1],[1,0]] invariant under swap
